comment: Areas of the repository: who may change what. Read by port/tools/check_area_scope.py and roadmap/tools/backlog.py; described in AREAS.md (its table is generated from this file). Patterns are fnmatch globs on repository paths; '*' also matches '/'. {ID} is the work-package ID (port-wp only). LOCKED: change only as the reviewer, then run python3 port/tools/protect.py.

shared.comment: Bookkeeping every area may write: its own task log file, and status lines of roadmap/BACKLOG.md.

areas.purpose: Reviewer and integrator of record: verifies all work (cpu_verify, reviews), merges area branches into the handoff branch, owns the locked tools, gates, checksums and the area definitions.
One work package of the code-only run of Phases 1-3 of the 4.6.0 port: only the WRF routines the package owns.
areas.who: a code-only worker (prompt B of port/agent/PROMPTS.md)

areas.purpose: Integrator of the code-only run: merges finished work-package branches into agent/code and keeps the workbook.
areas.who: the code-only integrator (prompt A of port/agent/PROMPTS.md)

areas.purpose: Development of the 4.6.0 port on a machine that can build and test it (H100 machine, CPU builds): WRF code, fixes found by tests, infrastructure tool fixes, results and the workbook.
Phase 0 runs on CCR (CPU reference builds and runs, reproducibility tests, reference archives): records results only.
areas.who: an agent or person with CCR access

areas.purpose: Planning and studies: architecture documents, analyses, proposed decisions (ADRs), backlog cards.
Performance models, profiling tools and performance reports (no changes to WRF or the port).
User-facing documentation and community files for the release.
Stage 2: WRF 4.8.0 (track V). Closed until the 4.6.0 port passes G5 (card A-29; ADR-002 stage gate).
areas.who: opened by the owner after A-29

areas.purpose: Stage 3: the CFBM fire model (track C). Closed until stage 2 is done (ADR-002 stage gate).
areas.who: opened by the owner after stage 2
